2609.09764.title: SocialRL: Refining LLMs' Social Intelligence through Multi-turn Reinforcement Learning and Reward Design
2609.09764.paper_summary: Social intelligence enables agents to read social context, infer intent, and adapt over sustained dialogue. As language models become autonomous collaborators, it is central to building effective and trustworthy human-AI interaction. Existing reinforcement learning methods optimize single-turn utterances and sparse outcome rewards, producing short-sighted policies that struggle to manage goal-relationship tensions across multi-turn interactions. We propose SocialRL, a multi-turn reinforcement learning framework addressing both challenges. First, we apply multi-turn reinforcement learning using PPO that propagates delayed outcome rewards back to each turn, enabling long-horizon planning. Second, we design six process reward dimensions capturing the goal-relationship trade-off, including goal advancement, relational attunement, contextual coherence, etc. A reward model dynamically generates fine-grained scoring criteria for each dimension, while a stage-aware weight schedule prioritizes relationship-building in early turns, goal advancement mid-way, and balanced closure late. Across multiple social-dialogue benchmarks, SocialRL improves Goal Achievement by an average of 9.2 percentage points over the corresponding Base models. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of SocialRL across synthetic and real social scenes, as well as standard and challenging social scenarios.
2609.09764.paper_summary_zh: 社會智能使代理能夠讀取社會背景、推斷意圖並在持續對話中適應。隨著語言模型成為自主的合作夥伴，建立有效且值得信賴的人機互動變得至關重要。現有的強化學習方法優化單回合的發言和稀疏的結果獎勵，產生短視的策略，難以管理多回合互動中的目標-關係緊張。我們提出了SocialRL，一個多回合強化學習框架，針對這兩個挑戰進行解決。首先，我們應用使用PPO的多回合強化學習，將延遲的結果獎勵回傳到每一回合，實現長期規劃。其次，我們設計了六個過程獎勵維度，以捕捉目標-關係的權衡，包括目標推進、關係調適、情境一致性等。獎勵模型動態生成每個維度的細緻評分標準，而階段感知的權重計劃在早期回合中優先考慮建立關係，在中途推進目標，並在後期實現平衡的結束。在多個社會對話基準測試中，SocialRL將目標達成率提高了平均9.2個百分點，超過相應的基準模型。這些結果展示了SocialRL在合成和真實社會場景以及標準和挑戰性社會情境中的有效性。
